mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, workflow_definition_id, workflow_version_id, status, input_json, output_json, current_node_key, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_summary, event_sequence, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_run ( workspace_id, workflow_definition_id, workflow_version_id, status, input_json, output_json, current_node_key, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_summary, event_sequence, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{workflowVersionId}, #{status}, #{inputJson}, #{outputJson}, #{currentNodeKey}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{errorCode}, #{errorSummary}, #{eventSequence}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM workflow_run WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_run SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', output_json = #{outputJson}, error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE workflow_run SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
